newsitem.title: USA: Ajay Sports says sold billiards line.
newsitem.headline: Ajay Sports says sold billiards line.

text.p: Ajay Sports Inc, maker of Spalding golf accessories and other leisure products, said it sold its billiards product line to a private company in Pennsylvania for cash and future royalty payments.
In its third-quarter statement, Ajay said it will use the cash for general working capital and expansion of its golf and casual living furniture businesses.
As reported earlier, Ajay posted a third-quarter loss of $0.03 a share versus a loss of $0.01 a year ago.
Chairman Thomas Itin said in the statement the results reflect performance consistent with the prior year in the company's core mass market golf and casual furniture businesses.

The losses were principally related to its Palm Springs Golf business which has been investing heavily in updating its golf club products and in adding bags, gloves and accessories to its 1997 line, Itin said.
In addition, sale of existing inventory to make way for the 1997 line negatively impacted Palm Springs' 1996 results, the company said.
